positioning.label: Who we are
positioning.p1: At JM GEO we are committed to surveying that keeps pace with today's technology.
positioning.p2: That is why we incorporate the latest innovations in digital measurement systems. We believe the combination of human dedication in the field and emerging technology is key to delivering the most rigorous results in building, energy and infrastructure projects.

cards.title: Topographic capture for projects
cards.short: Precise geospatial data acquisition with LiDAR technology and surveying methods for engineering, energy and civil works development.
cards.detail: Planned flights, geodetic support and full processing. CAD-ready deliverables: classified point clouds, DTM, DSM, orthophotos and contour lines.

cards.title: Construction support
cards.short: Setting out, execution control, monitoring and surveying assistance throughout every construction phase.
cards.detail: We support contractors and engineering firms from the initial setting out to final settlement, with documented traceability and the formats your team uses.

tech.label: Technology
tech.title: Precision equipment for every survey
tech.sub: We combine aerial LiDAR capture, GNSS positioning and total station to cover any project, from large areas down to millimetre detail.
tech.ctaSub: We study every case individually and propose the right technical approach.

blocks.label: Equipment 01
paragraphs: We mount high-density LiDAR sensors on DJI Matrice platforms to capture the terrain from the air. Each flight generates a cloud of millions of georeferenced points, even under vegetation.
Density is tailored to each project: from general reconnaissance of large areas to high-detail capture over infrastructure and complex terrain.
deliverables: Contour lines at the interval you need

blocks.label: Equipment 02
paragraphs: Multi-constellation GNSS receivers with RTK correction provide geodetic support for the entire capture. They are the reference that anchors each project to real-world coordinates.
We establish and measure the control points that guarantee centimetre-level accuracy and allow different techniques to be linked in a single reference system.

blocks.label: Equipment 03
paragraphs: For work where point accuracy is paramount, the total station measures angles and distances with millimetre tolerances. It is the precision complement to aerial capture.
We use it for setting out, geometric control on site and detailed surveys — wherever every point counts and the aerial laser lacks sufficient resolution.

about.label: About us
about.lead: We are a young company, yet the team brings years of experience in surveying and geomatics.
about.p1: We have worked in Portugal, Italy, Germany, the United Kingdom, France and Spain. Every project has been carried out with the utmost commitment and dedication. We feel our involvement has earned recognition, and that our measuring precision is the value our clients appreciate most.
about.p2: We are committed to surveying that keeps pace with today's technology. That is why we use the latest innovations in drones, 3D scanning and digital measurement systems. We believe the combination of our human dedication in the field and emerging technology is the key to delivering the most rigorous results in building, energy and infrastructure projects.
